findings.description: The bucket has no ACL set (comment indicates it is public) and no bucket policy restricting access, allowing unauthorized public read/write access to sensitive customer data.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket (including customer master data) are not encrypted at rest.
Versioning is not enabled, so objects can be overwritten or deleted without recovery, increasing risk of data loss or tampering going undetected.
A sensitive customer master spreadsheet is uploaded into the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket, which is publicly accessible and unencrypted, exposing sensitive customer data to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined for this financials bucket, leaving sensitive financial data unencrypted at rest.
Versioning is not enabled on the financials bucket, increasing risk of irrecoverable data loss or unauthorized overwrite/deletion.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined for this bucket, so stored operational data is not encrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined for this bucket, so stored data science data is not encrypted at rest.
